title: Need an honest site audit: Repeatedly rejected by AdSense for "Low Value Content" (Recipe Blog)
summary: Hi everyone, I’m looking for some constructive (and completely honest) feedback on our gastronomy blog. We’ve applied for Google AdSense multiple times now, but we keep getting turned down with the generic "Low Value Content" rejection message. Website: https://masemhalunkehen.hu Niche: Food & Recipes (Hungarian language) Background: Run by a team of 3 passionate creators. We write original recipes and shoot our own step-by-step photos in our own kitchen. What we have already done / checked: Originality: Every recipe is written from scratch based on our own cooking experience, paired with original photography. Core Pages: We have an About Us page introducing our team, Contact details, Privacy Policy, and an Impressum. Technical & Schema: The site is mobile-friendly, loads fine, and we use structured Recipe Schema markup. Where we would love your help: Since Google’s automated response is notoriously vague, we would deeply appreciate a fresh pair of eyes to help us pinpoint what might be triggering the "Low Value Content" filter: Does the layout, UX, or design look amateurish or thin to a first-time visitor? Are our E-E-A-T (Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness) signals weak or missing something obvious? Is the content structure or depth lacking from a SEO / value perspective? Feel free to be as blunt as needed, we really want to fix the issues and move forward! Thank you so much for taking a look!   submitted by   /u/Melodic_Bother_1376 [link]   [comments]
